import re
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    s=open(f'xl/worksheets/sheet{n}.xml').read()
    print(f'===== sheet{n}')
    # split rows
    rows = re.findall(r'<row r="(\d+)".*?</row>', s, flags=re.S)
    print('num rows parsed', len(rows))
    for m in re.finditer(r'<row r="(\d+)"[^>]*>(.*?)</row>', s, flags=re.S):
        r=m.group(1); body=m.group(2)
        cells = re.findall(r'<c r="([A-Z]+\d+)"([^>]*)>(.*?)</c>', body, flags=re.S)
        print('ROW', r)
        for ref, attrs, content in cells:
            t = re.search(r't="([^"]+)"', attrs)
            sref = re.search(r's="(\d+)"', attrs)
            f = re.search(r'<f>(.*?)</f>', content)
            v = re.search(r'<v>(.*?)</v>', content)
            ist = re.search(r'<t>(.*?)</t>', content)
            print('  ', ref, 's='+ (sref.group(1) if sref else '-'), 't='+(t.group(1) if t else '-'), 'f='+(f.group(1) if f else '-'), 'v='+(v.group(1) if v else '-'), 'str='+(ist.group(1) if ist else '-'))
